Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 -Order II r.2,3 - Joinder of causes of action – Order II r. 3 does not compel a plaintiff to join two or more causes of action in a single suit - The failure to join together all claims arising from a cause of action will be visited with consequences r. 2 - CPC permits a plaintiff to join causes of action but it does not compel a plaintiff to do so.
